ValidationRule.description: A branding return case must go to a vendor in the retailer's own hub. Enforced here because a lookup filter cannot compare a picklist across objects. Checked only once both vendor and hub are set, so it never blocks an in-progress record.
ValidationRule.errorConditionFormula: AND( Case_Type__r.Name = "Branding & Marketing Asset transfer Request", NOT(ISBLANK(Vendor__c)), NOT(ISBLANK(TEXT(Retailer_Hub__c))), TEXT(Vendor__r.Hub__c) <> TEXT(Retailer_Hub__c) )
ValidationRule.errorMessage: Selected vendor's hub does not match the retailer's hub. Choose a vendor mapped to the retailer's hub.
